_comment: The SCIENCE folio instance, staged as a top-level directory ahead of becoming its own repository -- the same pattern as who-iris/ and folio-assistant-core/. Owner, 2026-09-20: 'milnor goes in f-a-sci library/, move all 4 and fix fallout'. It exists because `milnorlink` is source material for mathematics and has nothing to do with the WHO IRIS catalogue, so sending it to who-iris/ alongside the three IRIS items would have put one thing in a place named for another. Bean r1lz. DECLARE ONLY WHAT EXISTS, per the dh4f rule: `library/` is the only entry, because it is the only directory here.

directories.description: Ingested L1 source material for the sciences. `milnorlink` is the whole of it: the source text the derived `milnor` skill reads, moved out of cat-harness/library/ because the PLATFORM holds no content (bean r1lz, and the rule AGENTS.md states as 'folio-assistant is the platform, not the content'). Its `image-verdicts.json` moved with it rather than staying behind: a verdict belongs to the library it judges, and one file judging documents in two libraries is how one library's judgement comes to rewrite another's sidecar. The id is `library`, the CONVENTIONAL one, so this entry OVERRIDES the default rather than joining it: overrides match on id and never on path, so a distinct id at the same path yields two entries for one directory and every fan-out consumer scans it twice. Measured while doing exactly that.
